storeStatus.suspendDescription: Customers cannot open or buy from the store, and messages to customers and payouts pause. Nothing is deleted.
storeStatus.reinstateDescription: The store opens to customers again, and the merchant's open appeal is marked resolved.
storeStatus.appealsLink: Open the appeals and requests from merchants
storeStatus.suspendBody: Suspend {name}? The merchant sees your reason in a banner on every page of their dashboard, and can appeal once.
storeStatus.reasonHint: Write it the way you would say it to them. Up to 500 characters.
storeStatus.reasonRequired: Write the reason first. The merchant needs to know why.
storeStatus.reinstateBody: Reinstate {name}? Customers can open and buy from it again straight away.
storeStatus.failed: The change did not go through. Nothing was changed. Try again.
storeStatus.suspendedToastBody: {name} is suspended. The merchant can see the reason and appeal.
